error: Retained recovery prefix does not match restored original receipts
rootCause: Turn.restore normalizes integral JSON floats with World._normalize_numbers. The prior raw report was not normalized before full-precision canonical equality, so equal receipt numeric values had different encodings. All 15 original JSON receipt responses match semantically.
minimalFix: Use the existing World._normalize_numbers on the detached parsed report before canonical comparison. No runtime snapshot, receipt, game source, predicate or phase is changed.
